name: 76306 · Wichita Falls, TX
findings: ZIP 76306 (Wichita Falls) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76306 (Wichita Falls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76306 (Wichita Falls) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
